definitions.explanation: The act of turning a vehicle to the right at an intersection or junction.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{交差点|こうさてん}を{右折|うせつ}する。
examples.english: Turn right at the next intersection.

examples.japanese: {右折|うせつ}{禁止|きんし}の{標識|ひょうしき}がある。
examples.english: There's a no right turn sign.

examples.japanese: {右折|うせつ}するときは{対向車|たいこうしゃ}に{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: Be careful of oncoming traffic when turning right.

notes:
{右折|うせつ} is the formal/technical term for turning right, commonly used in traffic contexts and directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右折|うせつ}する: to turn right
- {右折|うせつ}{禁止|きんし}: no right turn
- {右折|うせつ}{車線|しゃせん}: right turn lane
- {右折|うせつ}{専用|せんよう}: right turn only

TRAFFIC NOTES:
- In Japan, driving is on the left, so {右折|うせつ} crosses oncoming traffic
- {右折|うせつ} requires extra caution compared to {左折|させつ}
- Some intersections have {右折|うせつ}{信号|しんごう} (right turn signals)
